text:
Maya L: quick follow-up on the admit-window RFC — proposing we shrink the 'smoke acceptance window' for fastpath admits from 24h -> 4h to reduce churn and speed rollouts. thinking: shorter window + stricter stratified samplings. thoughts?
Kevin H: +1 to faster rollouts, but worried about missing slow-drift regressions. what metrics are we keeping during the 4h? :eyes:
Maya L: core idea: keep the normal telemetry (p50/p95 latency, error-rate) + add a lightweight quality probe set that hits the golden slices every 30m. also keep continuous embedding-drift (cosine) and a tiny perplexity delta check. it should be cheap.
Anita P: tradeoff note — smaller windows mean fewer rare-edge failures show up. suggest we keep a rolling observer cohort at 10% of traffic for 24h (observer = does not block rollout, only records). that gives visibility without blocking fastpath.
Kevin H: ok. can you sketch a rollout policy? i.e., canary percents, flag names, config example?
Maya L: propose config snippet: 
```json
{
  "feature_flag": "admit_fastpath_enabled",
  "canary_sequence": [5, 25, 100],
  "acceptance_window_minutes": 240,
  "observer_percent": 10,
  "smoke_checks": ["latency_p95", "error_rate", "embed_cosine_drift", "mini_perplexity"],
  "smoke_check_interval_minutes": 30
}
```
Kevin H: looks reasonable. how big is the mini golden set? need stratification by seqlen and domain.
Anita P: recommend stratify into 3 seqlen buckets (<=64, 65-512, 513+), and 5 domain buckets. total golden size ~150-300 inputs to keep runtime cheap while covering tails. also add a random short-seq heavy-weight sample to catch tokenization regressions.
Maya L: agree. operational plan: 1) implement flag + interval checks, 2) wire observer cohort, 3) run a 2-week shadow experiment with 4h window to measure missed regressions vs 24h baseline, 4) decide final.
Kevin H: do we need any runtime changes? e.g., fastpath needs to surface smoke-check telemetry to console traces.
Maya L: minimal change — a small telemetry fanout on admit path. i'll open a tiny PR that publishes a "smoke-accept" event with the check results and model_version metadata.
Anita P: don't forget to include model_variant and quantization tag in the telemetry; common source of drift.
Maya L: yeah will include model_variant and quant.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: feature/apply-smoke-window-refactor -> staging at 2024-09-12T15:30Z :rocket:
Kevin H: SGTM, if the PR includes the observer toggle and telemetry fields i'm good to help on the sampling harness. :thumbsup:
Maya L: thanks — i'll post the PR link here when ready and tag you for sampling harness review.
Anita P: :+1: also will draft the shadow experiment measurement plan and share by EOD.
